parameters.name: OrderKey
parameters.description:
The field used for sorting. If this parameter is not specified, no sorting is applied. Valid values:
- **Name**: the version name.
- **CreateTime**: the version creation time.
- **ModifyTime**: the version modification time.

parameters.name: OrderType
parameters.description:
The sort order. If this parameter is not specified, no sorting is applied. Valid values:

- **Asc**: ascending order.

- **Desc**: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: **1**. Valid values: **1 to 65535**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**. Valid values: **1 to 500**.

parameters.name: SearchType
parameters.description:
The type of fuzzy match. Valid values:
- **AppId**: the application ID.
- **Name**: the application name.
